inner_diameter = 23.9
length = 80.0
shoulder_length = 20.0

thread_pitch = 4.0
thread_depth = 1.5
thread_major_dia = 30.5
set_screw_dia = 5.0
set_screw_offset = 10.0
chamfer_size = 2.0
fillet_radius = 1.5

outer_radius = outer_diameter / 2.0
inner_radius = inner_diameter / 2.0
shoulder_radius = shoulder_diameter / 2.0
thread_major_radius = thread_major_dia / 2.0

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((0, 0), (0, outer_radius))
            l2 = Line(l1 @ 1, (length - shoulder_length, outer_radius))
            l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, (length - shoulder_length, shoulder_radius))
            l4 = Line(l3 @ 1, (length, shoulder_radius))
            l5 = Line(l4 @ 1, (length, 0))
            l6 = Line(l5 @ 1, (0, 0))
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.X)

solid_body = p.part
solid_body = solid_body - Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(inner_radius, length)
solid_body = solid_body - Pos(length, 0, 0) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(thread_major_radius, shoulder_length)

with BuildPart() as tp:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as tsk:
        with BuildLine() as tbl:
            tl1 = Line((thread_major_radius, 0), (thread_major_radius + thread_depth, thread_pitch / 2.0))
            tl2 = Line(tl1 @ 1, (thread_major_radius, thread_pitch))
            tl3 = Line(tl2 @ 1, (thread_major_radius, 0))
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=shoulder_length, taper=360 * shoulder_length / thread_pitch)

thread_solid = tp.part
solid_body = solid_body - thread_solid

max_x_face = x_faces[-1]
solid_body = chamfer(max_x_face.edges(), chamfer_size)
solid_body = fillet(solid_body.edges(), fillet_radius)

part = solid_body
part.name = "threaded_shaft_with_shoulder"
export_step(part, "output.step")
